Work & Skill Sets

I am a Principal Manager, Tech at D. E. Shaw within the commodities trading strategy team, with over nine years of experience engineering high-performance quantitative systems and data platforms. My work centers on architecting scalable data pipelines to ingest and process large-scale fundamental commodities market data, developing statistical and machine learning models for market forecasting, and building web-based analytical tool suites for options analytics and quantitative trading.

My technical skill sets span quantitative software engineering and data architecture—including Python, statistical modeling, high-throughput ETL pipelines, machine learning workflows, and distributed systems design. In addition, I build intuitive analytical interfaces using modern JavaScript, React, SQL, and MongoDB, bridging complex quantitative models with responsive, high-performance tooling for traders and researchers.
